status: PEDAGOGICAL_RECONSTRUCTION — not a quote from Abhinavagupta. Every component except ordering is grounded in the system.
objective: Visual + phonetic + respiratory + tactile + attentional embodiment of Sanskrit as Abhinavagupta practice.
rule_first: Sound + articulation + touch + body locus FIRST. Visualization comes after association is stable. Otherwise vague fantasy-map, not precise sensorimotor map.

stages.name: Varṇa
stages.goal: Extraordinary sensitivity to Sanskrit phonetics. Don't worry about Tantra yet.

stages.name: Sthāna
stages.goal: Mālinī/ Mātṛkā body coordinates using touch.

stages.name: Karaṇa
stages.goal: Body reproduces map without needing touch; posture quiet enough that each locus is distinct.

stages.name: Dhyāna
stages.goal: Add Devanāgarī glyph, later traditional visual qualities.

stages.name: Uccāra
stages.goal: Utterance rides breath; sound shifts audible → subtle → purely mental.

stages.name: Saṃhāra / Sṛṣṭi
stages.goal: Run map inward toward undifferentiated awareness and back outward into articulated sound/body/world.

touch_ladder: external touch (hand on locus while uttering)
progression_per_phoneme: hear X → touch locus → say X
hear X → feel locus without touch → say X
internally generate X → locus immediately salient
add glyph: न + na + articulation + crown + felt attention
target_event: A single event contains glyph + sound + articulation + body-locus + felt attention.

two_directions.saṃhara: Mālinī reverse roughly feet→head; fiery imagery consuming ordinary body-construction
two_directions.srsti: normal head→feet; nectarean/luminous imagery reconstructing divine Śakti-body
two_directions.boundary: Do not start with secret mantra-framing or initiation ritual — those assume initiated practitioner/teacher. Self-study layer: phonemes + pronunciation + published Mālinī sequence + body map.

role_map.flood: theory of what you're doing (entextualisation) — not a daily syllabus
role_map.malinivijayottara: technical substrate (order, body map, samāveśa components)

why: First two phonemes of the normal alphabet (Stage I varṇa order)
Head/face loci are easiest precise touch targets (forehead, mouth/face)
PTv: a=anuttara/cit · ā=ānanda — powers as secondary layer only
a is the aham master-key phoneme (emergence)
Short session possible; depth over volume
openers_rationale.next_pairs: i ī → u ū → e o → aṃ aḥ → then consonant pairs ka+kha, ga+gha, etc.
